title: DeLonge: Iraq war linked to groups connected with nonhuman entities

tellings.quote: early interviews before anyone knew who his advisers were, he was talking about how some of the things that we did in Iraq may have been related to certain groups of people there who were connected with certain nonhuman entities and were helping them proliferate.

plain: Some of what the US did in Iraq after 2003 may have been aimed at groups of people there who were connected with nonhuman beings and were helping them spread. The researcher Jason Simosa tells Michels that the rock musician Tom DeLonge, who later founded a UFO research company, said this in early interviews, before anyone knew who his advisers were. If true, the war would have had a hidden purpose tied to non-human contact.
